purpose: Hand-authored development training and calibration for an answerability dependency classifier; not release evaluation.
limitations: These examples are authored development data, not a representative population sample or an accuracy guarantee.
Training and calibration share broad domains and ordinary wording patterns, but no contrastive group crosses partitions.
Prior turns supply general task context only; no historical private fact value is included as authority.
Only text and prior_turns are input features. IDs, group, domain, split, mode, and general_request are labels or audit metadata.
No fresh release-case corpus or benchmark answer labels were used to author these cases.

label_policy.none: Current input and general knowledge suffice, including disclosures, fully supplied planning constraints, and resolved general or drafting followups.
label_policy.optional: A useful general answer is explicitly acceptable; missing saved personalization may help but is not necessary.
label_policy.required: The requested answer or constrained task depends on an unstated previously supplied personal fact; old task history does not authorize its value.
label_policy.clarify: The request, object, referent, or intended change is unresolved even before any personal-fact lookup.
label_policy.general_request: For mixed required cases only, an exact contiguous standalone general subrequest copied from the input.
